title: Does my game look AI?
author: because-potato
selftext:
Open to suggestion. Ignore the purple - it’s a location based game and the purple is street names. 

I did some of the visuals but not all. My biggest issue is inconsistency of pixel size due to scaling animations to be better relative sizes, but besides that I feel like it looks pretty good.

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body:
So much of this sub is pixel art that my brain begins to associate pixel art with AI...

So yes, it looks AI to me.

replies.author: Ball_Analytics
replies.body: You weren't kidding and I'd not realised it.

replies.author: Zboubkiller
replies.body: it's the easy way to make sprites which are not that glitched or bad with open source light models, you can set up a comfyUI workflow in 20 minutes for it too, that's why it's everywhere

replies.author: KS-Wolf-1978
replies.body: I am a long time Comfy user, there are plenty of ways to get beautiful full resolution game assets both 2d and 3d and 100% locally.

replies.author: Zboubkiller
replies.body: not fast or possible with a shit rig tho

replies.author: KS-Wolf-1978
replies.body:
It is all about priorities.

If one is serious about developing a game solo, then buy a serious machine even if it means riding a bicycle instead of driving a car.

comments.author: PleasantCitron1685
comments.body: Yes, mostly because of the trees; everything else looks normal

comments.author: deific_
comments.body: The trees 100% look like everyone else’s trees that are using AI.

comments.author: aGKamui
comments.body: Yes, the trees, the UI, the sprites, i'd be surprised if you have a single thing here that's not made by AI

replies.author: because-potato
replies.body: UI and trees are the only things I made lol

comments.author: Edenisb
comments.body: I don't understand your ground covering

comments.author: aberroco
comments.body:
Yep, by a glance, from a mile away.

Menu, assets, colors, inconsistencies everywhere.

comments.author: Novaworld7
comments.body: Does it matter. In 2-5 years it's all going to be AI (largely)

comments.author: mahrogamers
comments.body: Yeah, I think the scaling is probably what makes it feel a bit AI-ish.

comments.author: SlashForward
comments.body: You have some high detailed assets like the backpack and trees, and then lower detailed assets like the road and menu. That contradiction would signal AI to me.
